releaseEvidence: The release's own files (windows-release.json, windows-signature.json, update-package.json, RELEASE-MANIFEST.json, Sigstore-signed SHA256SUMS), its ten windows-release.mjs stages on chromium/next (signing run 44923135363, staging gate 44924443284, verify-public 44924998686), the candidate's runner checks (44922671476, 44922682745), and chromium/STATUS.md's Windows section on chromium/next.

decisions: A Windows beta is its own GitHub pre-release, never latest, tagged chromium-beta-windows-<version>, version 158.0.8127.<build> (owner, 2026-11-19).

On /download it gets its own tile right after the Mac beta's, in the same dark style, never a platform choice (owner, 2026-11-21, from two layouts). The button goes to /dl/beta-win on the blanc-ping Worker, counted like the other /dl/* routes.
The tile's limits match the release notes the owner approved on 2026-11-21: no protected video, and some Blanc features behave differently on Windows.

158.0.8127.903 (owner, 2026-11-21: "release the next Windows beta"): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 158.0.8127.902; only the release it names changes, matching the release notes the owner approved for it.

claims.text: Blanc built directly on Chromium, for Windows.
claims.evidence: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (windows-release.json's candidate windows-x64-f12188c27d3b5d32, tree 96315b04c); the approved release notes say the same.

claims.text: It installs beside Blanc and never replaces it.
claims.evidence: Its own install folder (Blanc Beta), app id and Start menu entry; the runner's install check (44922671476) and the release's staging gate (44924443284) and verify-public (44924998686) record Electron Blanc's executable and uninstall entry unchanged through install.
windows-release.json build 903; the version's last number.
windows-release.json version 158.0.8127.903, the version the installed beta and blanc.day's update server report.
The fork's pinned Chromium 158.0.8127.2; chrome/VERSION is unchanged from upstream, and the Windows beta's version replaces only its last number at build time (patch 0103).
The fork's Chromium pin 158.0.8127.2 (chromium/lanes/desktop.json); the beta replaces only its last number with its build.

claims.text: x64 Windows PCs · tested on Windows 11
claims.evidence: The release is windows-x64 (windows-release.json platform); its runner checks ran on Windows Server 2025 and the hand checks on Windows 11, matching the approved release notes ("Made for x64 Windows PCs and tested on Windows 11").
The GitHub pre-release chromium-beta-windows-158.0.8127.903 was published on 2026-11-21 at 16:30 UTC.
/dl/beta-win redirects to the release's public Blanc-Beta-Setup-158.0.8127.903.exe (cloudflare/ping-worker/src/dl.js).

claims.text: Protected video, such as Netflix or Spotify.
claims.evidence: The Windows beta is built without Widevine (enable_widevine = false in chromium/windows/args/beta-x64.gn); the approved release notes say protected video doesn't play.

claims.text: Some Blanc features still behave differently on Windows.
claims.evidence: The fork's suite on Windows does not pass every case (W2: 625 of 667, chromium/reports/w2-windows-triage.md on chromium/next); the approved release notes say the same.
